answer: A refundable work bond keeps fake identities out: newcomers start on an ivory tier of low-value tasks and, before they can vouch for anyone, must complete verified paid work over several weeks and post a stake that is slashed if their endorsements prove fraudulent. A comet of new accounts cannot shortcut this, because each identity must earn its own pigment of trust one job at a time, so spinning up thousands of Sybils costs thousands of bonds plus weeks of real work, while honest agents keep their stake and standing.
